project.description: Renders HPDS configuration templates with environment-specific values and uploads to S3. Each template resolves from the stack-specific S3 override, shared S3 override, or infrastructure repository fallback.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: INFRASTRUCTURE_GIT_HASH
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Git hash of the infrastructure repo to checkout

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: RENDER_AUTH_HPDS
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Render and upload the auth HPDS env file

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: RENDER_OPEN_HPDS
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Render and upload the open HPDS env file

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e
# Source folder containing the scripts source_scripts_folder="${JENKINS_HOME}/workspace/Bash_Functions/"
# Iterate through the files in the folder and source them for script_file in "$source_scripts_folder"*.sh; do chmod +x "$script_file" if [ -f "$script_file" ] && [ -x "$script_file" ]; then echo "sourcing $script_file" source "$script_file" fi done
cd app-infrastructure/template-renderer
# Download S3-staged templates if they exist, otherwise fall back to repo versions echo "Attempting to download templates from S3..."
download_s3_template() { local object_key=$1 local destination=$2 local aws_error local candidate
if ! candidate=$(mktemp "$(dirname "$destination")/.template-download.XXXXXX"); then echo "Error: could not create a temporary template file." >&2 return 2 fi if aws_error=$(aws s3 cp "s3://${stack_s3_bucket}/${object_key}" "$candidate" 2>&1 >/dev/null); then if [ ! -s "$candidate" ]; then rm -f "$candidate" echo "Error: s3://${stack_s3_bucket}/${object_key} is empty; refusing to use it." >&2 return 2 fi if ! mv "$candidate" "$destination" >/dev/null 2>&1; then rm -f "$candidate" echo "Error: could not promote downloaded template to $destination." >&2 return 2 fi return 0 fi
rm -f "$candidate" case "$aws_error" in *"An error occurred (404)"*|*"An error occurred (NoSuchKey)"*|*"An error occurred (NotFound)"*) return 1 ;; esac
echo "Error: could not read s3://${stack_s3_bucket}/${object_key}; refusing to fall back after a non-missing-object AWS error." >&2 return 2 }
resolve_template() { local template_file=$1 local download_status
if download_s3_template "configs/hpds/templates/${TARGET_STACK}/${template_file}" "templates/${template_file}"; then echo "Using stack-specific S3 template for ${template_file}" return 0 else download_status=$? if [ "$download_status" -ne 1 ]; then return "$download_status" fi fi
if download_s3_template "configs/hpds/templates/${template_file}" "templates/${template_file}"; then echo "Using shared S3 template for ${template_file}" return 0 else download_status=$? if [ "$download_status" -ne 1 ]; then return "$download_status" fi fi
echo "No S3 template found, using repo version of ${template_file}" }
if [ "${RENDER_AUTH_HPDS}" = "true" ]; then resolve_template "hpds-auth.env.tftpl" fi
if [ "${RENDER_OPEN_HPDS}" = "true" ]; then resolve_template "hpds-open.env.tftpl" fi
terraform init -input=false
terraform apply -auto-approve -input=false \ -var="stack_s3_bucket=${stack_s3_bucket}" \ -var="environment_name=${environment_name}" \ -var="target_stack=${TARGET_STACK}" \ -var="env_private_dns_name=${env_private_dns_name}" \ -var="render_auth_hpds=${RENDER_AUTH_HPDS}" \ -var="render_open_hpds=${RENDER_OPEN_HPDS}" \ -var="render_visualization=false"
